_comment: Allowlist for axe-core findings that are accepted as known issues. Each entry suppresses one (ruleId, selector) pair on one or more routes. Critical-severity findings cannot be allowlisted — fix or revert. See docs/GDD.md §13.4.2.

_schema.selector: CSS selector matched by the violation
routes: string[] of e2e route names; '*' for all
_schema.expiresOn: ISO date; CI fails when expired
